title: Treat passing witnesses as state transitions
failure_signature: After a passing witness automatically promoted a method to validated, a redundant explicit validated transition was rejected as validated-to-validated.
trigger_preconditions: Passing witness appended to a candidate method
candidate_workaround: After appending a witness, inspect the runner result or summary and call set-state only when a distinct allowed transition remains necessary.
recurrence_guard: Model witness append as a possible state mutation; never issue an unconditional duplicate promotion.
rollback: The rejected duplicate transition did not change the ledger; retain it and continue from the auto-promoted validated state.
scope_boundary: This method addresses Method Flow state handling only and proves no scientific, authority, production, deployment, privacy, security, accessibility, identity, personhood, or independent-reproduction claim.
